layers: Voltage baseline Dense(1) + head Dense(96,tanh) -> Dense(48,tanh) -> Dense(1)
Current baseline Dense(1) + head Dense(32,tanh) -> Dense(16,tanh) -> Dense(1)
Humidity baseline Dense(1) + head Dense(32,tanh) -> Dense(16,tanh) -> Dense(1)
Post-model adaptive centered FIR voltage refinement; largest window 201 samples
Huber loss with voltage weight 2.0; ridge-stabilized baseline

residual_model_selection.selection_rule: Use residual only when voltage MAE+0.25*RMSE improves by at least 0.5%, voltage worst-case does not grow by more than 1 mV, and current MAE/worst-case remain bounded; otherwise restore the regularized baseline.

feature_transform: standardized raw inputs; total-degree 8 interaction polynomial basis; all expanded features standardized
